brief: Local design exploration of neogen.store — a Saudi bilingual (AR/EN) e-commerce shop for next-generation tech and smart-home products. Inherits Brand Tokens v2.0 (R6 Sky + Cool White): light-mode, sky-blue accent #38BDF8, slate text, Chakra Petch / Manrope / IBM Plex Mono with Rakkas + Tajawal + Reem Kufi for Arabic. Tone: precise, technical, forward-looking; spec-led product copy; no marketing superlatives.

styles.label: Operator Atlas
styles.description: R6-faithful baseline. Strict Sky + Cool White, hairline-grid body texture, IBM Plex Mono SKU pills, dense 12px row rhythm. Reads like a clean technical datasheet.

styles.label: Saudi Linen
styles.description: Premium calm. Warm-shifted off-white surfaces (still neutral, no yellow), Rakkas Arabic hero at 1.2× scale, photographic categories rack, dimmed ticker. Catalogue not terminal.

styles.label: Sky Workshop
styles.description: R6 with embellishment turned up. Accent-wash hero lattice, --shadow-md cards lifting to --shadow-lg on hover, cyan-pulse LED rack rows, Major Mono Display for section numerals. Workshop-floor energy.

pages.label: Operator Atlas — full homepage
pages.description: R6-faithful working ops console. 48px hairline body grid + cursor-tracked sky radial, dense 4-tile hero collage, neutral surface-2 ticker, monoline SVG rack icons, tight 3-col cards, dark indigo service band.

pages.label: Saudi Linen — full homepage
pages.description: Quiet editorial. Linen-warm bg, no body grid, single accent-wash radial behind hero, oversized Rakkas Arabic h1, single large hero panel, dimmed ticker, generous card padding, photographic category tiles, pill brand chips, light service band with accent stripe.

pages.label: Sky Workshop — full homepage
pages.description: Precision workshop console. Strict R6, lattice hero (grid + dual accent-wash radials), Major Mono Display section numerals, hover-lift hero collage, architectural ticker with accent-deep separators, cyan-pulse LED keyframes on rack hover, indigo-deep service band with sky CTA glow.
